# Tilt Joins Y Combinator’s Winter 2021 Batch


[Deepak VS](https://medium.com/@DeepakVS?source=post_page---byline--3bcd2e314f0c---------------------------------------)


1 min read


·


Mar 20, 2021


--


We’re excited to announce that Tilt has been funded by Y Combinator as part of their W21 batch.


Press enter or click to view image in full size


Y Combinator (YC) is a startup fund and program. Since 2005, YC has invested in nearly 3,000 companies including Airbnb, DoorDash, Stripe, Instacart, Dropbox, and Coinbase. The combined valuation of YC companies is over $300B.


Over the last three months, we’ve had the opportunity to interact with people from across the YC ecosystem. From hearing the Airbnb founders speak to brainstorming with incredibly smart batchmates, this has been the experience of a lifetime. A huge thank you to the YC team, the YC founders community and especially to our group partners —[Harj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harjtaggar/) ,[Dalton](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daltoncaldwell/) and[Nicholas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicolasdessaigne/) .


Tilt is changing the way campuses commute. Our bicycles and e-bikes allow communities to move around their campus without having to wait or break a sweat. Today, we work with some of India’s largest companies, including Tata Motors, ONGC Petro, TCS, Palava City, Mahindra and Tata Steel.


We are excited to share more with you soon!
